facts.text: Andrew expressed gratitude to Audrey for her support and mentioned that he has managed to care for his dogs while living in the city.

evidence.quote: Thanks Audrey! That's so nice of you. I think I've managed to make it work with dogs while still living in the city.

facts.text: Audrey affirmed Andrew's situation and emphasized the importance of keeping dogs active as a key aspect of city dog care.

evidence.quote: Taking care of a pup in the city is tough but doable with the right approach. Keeping them active is key.

facts.text: Audrey shared a photo of a basket full of stuffed animals on a wooden floor, which she described as a way to entertain her dogs in the house.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of how I entertain them in my house with toys and games.

facts.text: Audrey encouraged Andrew to focus on making his current dogs happy and healthy before considering adding more dogs to his household.

evidence.quote: Maybe you want to take care of Toby and Buddy first. Having them happy and healthy would be a good first step before going all in for more dogs.
